name: devsbooth
description: Self-hosted audio rooms for developers. Sign in with an email code, open a room, talk.
author: Daniel Tyukov

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n db,server,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev:db -w server" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared --noEmit && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p web --noEmit && tsc -p e2e --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
